customer_ops_alex: Hey team — our nightly bulk ingest has been getting intermittent 429s during the 02:00-03:00 UTC window for the past 3 nights. Org: jupiter-demo. We saw a spike in requests and then `rate_limit_exceeded` in the API logs. Can we get a quick temporary lift or a mitigation? This is blocking a demo tonight.

maria_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a sample request_id and the timestamp from the API error? Also are you using one API key or multiple service keys across the batch job?

customer_ops_alex: Sample error: `request_id=01F6QXZ9ABCD` from 2026-03-15T02:14:08Z. We run 5 parallel worker pods each sending batches of 200 small prompts (aggregate token usage ~20k tokens/min). We are rotating between 3 keys (legacy tokens) per pod.

tim_devops: FWIW, rotating keys can actually spread you across per-key limits but still hit org-level rate ceilings. From the logs I pulled for that request_id I see headers: `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 24` (seconds). Looks like short-term burst quota exhausted then retried and tripped again.

sre_kate: Quick mitigation: 1) reduce concurrent workers to 2 for the window 02:00-03:30, 2) add exponential backoff on 429s (start 500ms, cap 2s, jitter), 3) consolidate to a single dedicated key for the job so you get a single smoother rate allocation.

maria_support: Also helpful for us: can you share a minimal repro curl so we can reproduce on our side? e.g.:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "X-Org-Id: jupiter-demo" \n  -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":32}'
```
We only need one reproduction that triggers the 429 pattern.

customer_ops_alex: Pasting a condensed repro log attached. We'll run the single-key repro by lunchtime. We need to know if there's a short-term option from sales to bridge tonight.

jen_sales: We can offer a temporary quota bridge (sales-assisted uplift) for 24–72 hours while onboarding to a paid tier. It's subject to billing authorization and requires an org admin sign-off. I can approve a 36-hour bridge pending legal/billing OK. Tell me the desired increase (rps or daily tokens).

customer_ops_alex: Ideally +3x throughput for the 02:00-04:00 window tonight and tonight only. We'll provide card/billing details asap.

tim_devops: One more thing — I noticed one of your pods uses an old client that retries without jitter; that causes retry storms. If you can't whitelist a bridge by time, throttling client-side is safest.

maria_support: If you want us to attempt a temporary uplift now, please confirm: 1) org admin email, 2) exact time window, 3) desired multiplier or target rps. We can open the bridge request to Finance/Sales.

customer_ops_alex: Org admin: ops@jupiter.inc. Window: 02:00-05:00 UTC tonight. Target: approx. 3x current throughput (~60k tokens/min).

jen_sales: Noted. I'll start the paperwork + billing hold. Finance usually signs off within 2–3 hours for small short-term bridges. I also need the account's billing contact and whether they accept a pre-authorized charge.

deploybot: Automated note: no platform deploys scheduled in 01:30-05:30 UTC.

sre_kate: While sales/finance process the bridge, implement the three mitigations (consolidate key, reduce concurrency, add jitter). That will reduce failed requests and avoid hitting fallback throttles. Once we have the uplift in place we can scale back up gracefully.

customer_ops_alex: Thanks — implementing now. Will post results of single-key repro in ~45m. Appreciate the fast response. :pray: 

maria_support: Thanks — looping in infra team if we see org-level throttles. Please include a sample `request_id` in the follow-up message so we can correlate. :eyes:
